replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: A $20 ChatGPT or Claude account should be enough to get started. Then just talk with it and tell it what you want to build. Have it ask you questions about how you want the game to work, what engine would work best, and how you want it played(mobile, pc, vr, etc). Ask it for help if you are ever stuck or not sure what to do.
